newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangxi ITIC signs US$15 mln transferable loan.
newsitem.headline: Guangxi ITIC signs US$15 mln transferable loan.

text.p: Guangxi International Trust and Investment Corp's 364-day transferable loan facility has been increased to US$15 million from US$10 million due to oversubscription, said arranger Credit Suisse Hong Kong.
The all-in return for top-tier managers is 135 basis points.
Six banks in addition to Credit Suisse participated in the facility.
Australia and New Zealand Banking Group is co-arranger.
Korea Merchant Banking Corp and National Australia Finance (Asia) Ltd are senior managers.
BfG Bank AG, Hongkong Chinese Bank Ltd and UBAF (Hong Kong) Ltd are managers.
